title: eludite.agents.new_session input
description: Start a new session, as the Agents window's New session button (`+` in the header) does: the agent is started with ACP initialize and session/new and the new session becomes the one the window shows; the session shown before keeps running. At most 8 sessions are live at once: a ninth stops the oldest idle one (its record stays). Answers the state (agents-state.output.json).

agent.description: The name of an agent in the registry (see the state's `agents`); by default the window's selected agent.
